title: The Installment a TRICARE Select Bank Draft Is Recorded Against
content:
**Clause.** For a one-time bank draft on a fee-bearing **TRICARE Select** enrollment, which installment is the latest installment depends on the enrollment's standing: where the enrollment has ended, it is the installment charged for the installment period that contains the last day of coverage, read as the charges whose coverage period starts in that period, no later than the month containing the last day of coverage and no later than the payment date; where the enrollment has not ended and a charge has been made for a coverage period starting in the installment period that contains the payment date, on or before that date, it is that period's charges; otherwise it is the enrollment's first installment, the charge whose coverage period starts on the effective date. The earlier counted charges are the charges that count toward the past-due balance other than those of the latest installment.

An enrollment has ended when its status is disenrolled voluntarily, disenrolled for nonpayment, terminated as ineligible or transferred out, whatever the payment date; its last day of coverage is then the disenrollment date on its record.

## Points of judgement

| Enrollment on the payment date | Latest installment | Earlier counted charges |
|---|---|---|
| ended (status disenrolled, terminated as ineligible or transferred out) | the charges for the installment period containing the last day of coverage, starting no later than that day's month and no later than the payment date | the counted charges other than those |
| not ended, with a charge for a period starting in the current installment period on or before the payment date | that period's charges; a charge billed ahead for a later period is not part of it | the counted charges other than those |
| not ended, no such charge | the first installment, whose coverage period starts on the effective date | the counted charges other than it |

## Hypothetical illustrations (quarterly installment periods)

- Active enrollment, payment on 2026-08-05, charges for the quarters starting 2026-04-01, 2026-07-01 and 2026-10-01: the latest installment is the July charge.
- Enrollment ended with a last day of coverage of 2026-05-15, payment on 2026-08-05: the latest installment is the charge for the quarter starting 2026-04-01.
- Enrollment effective 2026-06-10 whose only charge is its first installment, with no charge yet for the July quarter, payment on 2026-07-20: the latest installment is the first installment, and it is not among the earlier counted charges.
